description: What an ASF project is born with (D-8.28): the files and folders a host copies from this repository into the root of the project's docs repo at a tagged ref, the empty folders it creates, and the files it generates. A stack born from exactly this validates with zero errors — tools/test-skeleton.py proves it at every change.

generated..asf/state.json: meta.schema_version (the one state.schema.json accepts) and meta.asf_version, project.name, and the two required collections empty: epics [] and requirements.functional []

placeholders.{asf_version}: the adopted version, without the leading v

host_files..gitlab-ci.yml: the docs pipeline, written by the host because it carries the host's runners: at least the validate-stack job of deployment.md §8.4
